why: The lesson's listed common mistake: view_classify(image, probabilities) instead of probabilities[0]. model.predict ran (its 1/1 progress line printed) but barh got a (1, 10) array and raised, leaving an empty figure. The probability chart the step is about was never drawn.

append.source:
def view_classify(image, probabilities):
    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(figsize=(6,9), ncols=2)
    ax1.imshow(image)
    ax1.axis('off')
    ax2.barh(np.arange(10), probabilities)
    ax2.set_aspect(0.1)
    ax2.set_yticks(np.arange(10))
    ax2.set_yticklabels(np.arange(10))
    ax2.set_title('Class Probability')
    ax2.set_xlim(0, 1.1)
    plt.tight_layout()

image, label = test_images[0], test_labels[0]
probabilities = model.predict(image.reshape(1, 28, 28, 1))
view_classify(image, probabilities)
